question: Should Gitcrawl adopt the linked PR’s first-version `fill-pr-details` command, flags, JSON progress schema, ordering defaults, and stop-at-reserve behavior as supported CLI surface?
rationale: The implementation is focused and has real CLI proof, but the permanent command and long-running quota contract are product choices that automation cannot safely settle.

options.title: Accept after rebase
options.body: Resolve the current-base conflict, rerun focused validation, and accept the proposed bounded stop-and-resume interface.

options.title: Narrow the interface
options.body: Keep the implementation approach but request changes to naming, flags, output schema, ordering, or quota behavior before merge.

options.title: Defer core surface
options.body: Pause the pull request and keep this issue as the design home until a first-class bounded fill command is desired.

recommendation.title: Accept after rebase
recommendation.body: Resolve the current-base conflict, rerun focused validation, and accept the proposed bounded stop-and-resume interface.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced and hardened the existing PR-detail CLI surface and is the strongest history-backed decision owner for extending that contract.
